audio_sink.what: null adapter — no audio hardware exists in this sandbox; samples are mixed by audio-engine and rendered into the null device's ring, whose sample counter drives the audio-master clock (a moving position after `play` IS the audio limb being exercised end to end)
audio_sink.real_path: the typed OS-backend stubs in audio-output (card 2.C3; real backends land in platform-* per doc 01 §2.7 behind ADR-005 — the cpal P0 record docs/dependencies/records/cpal-0.18.2.md)

video_render.what: software compositor, headless — no GPU exists in this sandbox; frames stage through the measured CPU path and the PNG is encoded by the std-only stored-deflate encoder
video_render.real_path: the wgpu backend is typed + shape-pinned but deferred per the 2.D1 record docs/dependencies/records/wgpu-30.0.1.md (admission gated on the libloading disposition)

clock.what: virtual time — the host's bounded `advance` pumps are the only time mover (the poll-driven single-writer model; no wall-clock sleeps anywhere, hence the byte-determinism proofs)
clock.real_path: the wall-clock session thread is card 3.B3
